tools.name: agent_run
tools.intent: Start or resume a long-running multi-step Exa research or list-building run with structured output; prefer over repeated searches for cross-source verification.

tools.name: web_fetch_exa
tools.intent: Read the full content of known URLs as clean markdown, batching several in one call; use after search when highlights are insufficient.

tools.name: web_search_exa
tools.intent: Semantic web search that takes a description of the ideal page and returns clean content; the first step for finding current information.
